author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In OpenAI's article, The Future of the Firm, the author envision 3 ways AI enters the firm.

Myself as an AI native engineer, an AI native manager in an AI native firm, I can say with certainty that the 3 ways are WRONG.

It is same org-chart just like before, but every single dot is half white and half blue. There will be no worker who doesn't use AI, and every single AI agent has a human master at the other end.

Just like cloud computer is someone else's server. The AI agents is not a magic fake human that can breath on its own, it is a complex piece of software/hardware that needs a team of engineers to support it running smoothly.
